aim_summary.goal: Replace the fillet at the front center with a 1 millimeter chamfer while preserving the rest of the model.
preserve_targets: all model geometry outside the front-center edge treatment
aim_summary.expected_outcome: The front-center fillet is absent and a 1 millimeter chamfer occupies its former edge-treatment location, with all other geometry unchanged.

operations_plan.summary: Replace the front-center fillet with a 1 millimeter chamfer.

steps.description: Restore the sharp corner underlying the front-center fillet.
Apply the requested 1 millimeter chamfer to the regenerated front-center sharp edge.

expected_result.geometry: The front-center fillet is removed and replaced at the same edge-treatment location by a 1 millimeter chamfer.

validation_criteria.description: No fillet remains at the identified front-center location.
A chamfer exists at the front-center location with a size of 1 millimeter.
The chamfer occupies the edge-treatment location of the removed fillet.
All geometry and dimensions outside the targeted front-center edge treatment remain unchanged.
